name: create_and_run_clash_test
author: hprebar
title: Create and run a clash test
description: HEAVY: creates a Clash Detective test between two searches (a and b, each category/property/op/value), with a tolerance in millimetres, and runs it. Needs 'Allow heavy operations' ticked in the bridge window; the run cannot be interrupted or undone (the test definition itself is undoable), may take minutes on big models — save the file first. Returns result counts by status and the elapsed time; read results with get_clash_results.

name.description: Display name of the new clash test

toleranceMm.description: Clash tolerance in millimetres (0 = any intersection)

a.description: Selection A as a search: {category, property, op, value}

category.description: Property category display name as shown in the Properties window, e.g. Item, Element, Revit Type

property.description: Property display name inside that category, e.g. Name, Type, Level

op.description: equals compares the display string; contains / wildcard (* and ?) match text; gt / lt compare numbers

value.description: Value to compare with (numbers as text for gt / lt)

b.description: Selection B as a search: {category, property, op, value}

category.description: Property category display name as shown in the Properties window, e.g. Item, Element, Revit Type

property.description: Property display name inside that category, e.g. Name, Type, Level

op.description: equals compares the display string; contains / wildcard (* and ?) match text; gt / lt compare numbers

value.description: Value to compare with (numbers as text for gt / lt)
